raw_sections.experience:
Business Analyst / Product Owner
WORK EXPERIENCE
London Stock Exchange Group - Bangalore, Karnataka,India Business Analyst | February 2025- Present
Conducted business analysis across Trading and Capital Markets, delivering 15+ product
enhancements and reducing requirement clarification cycles by 25%.
Authored and maintained 150+ user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring complete traceability
from requirements through UAT.
Managed and refined the product backlog by creating epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and
functional requirements using Agile methodologies.
Collaborated with Product Owners, Engineering, QA, Data Engineering, AI/ML, and cross-functional
business teams to deliver product enhancements throughout the Software Development Life
Cycle (SDLC).
Mapped and optimized 20+ business processes, identifying automation opportunities that reduced
manual effort and improved operational efficiency.
Performed data analysis, validation, root cause analysis using SQL, Excel to support data-driven
decision-making and ensure data quality.
Developed 15+ Power BI dashboards, reducing manual reporting effort by 40% and improving KPI
visibility for data driven decision making
Produced and maintained 50+ BRDs, FRDs, process flows, and knowledge articles, improving
documentation quality and project onboarding using Confluence
Leveraged Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar LLMs) for
requirement elicitation, documentation generation and user story creation
Trained and mentored junior analysts on BRD/FRD preparation, requirement analysis and review
processes.
Tracxn - Bangalore, Karnataka, India Business Analyst |February, 2022 - January,2025 (3 years)
Conducted Business Analysis across Retail, Banking, Finance, Payments, Energy, AI/ML, and
Security and Supply Chains domains, gathering requirements through BRDs, FRDs, user
stories, and process flows.
Led requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, gap analysis, and impact analysis,
translating business needs into functional requirements using Agile/Scrum across the SDLC.
Analyzed data using SQL, Python, Excel, and Power BI to support business decisions and
develop KPI dashboards and executive reports.
Managed requirements and project documentation using JIRA and Confluence, ensuring end-
to-end traceability.
Performed data validation, root cause analysis, and process improvement initiatives, reducing
reporting errors by 20% and resolving 5,000+ data issues.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver business solutions and mentored junior
analysts on BRD/FRD documentation and best practices.
Zinnov Management Solutions - Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
ResearchSpecialist|June,2021 - January,2022(9months)
Conducted in-depth research on domestic and global markets to support client projects.
Developed structured data collection frameworks and identified new information sources.
Delivered high-quality research and insights to help clients make strategic decisions.
Supported consumer and market research to uncover actionable insights for business
growth. Managed a team of 6 interns, exceeding client SLAs and performance metrics.
Focused on IT and Digital Service Provider landscape, including SMAC (Social, Mobility,
Analytics, Cloud, IoT) research to deliver data-driven solutions.
